summary: Vortex Indicator: VI+ and VI- lines from upward and downward vortex movement over 14 bars, compared with true range.
overview: The Vortex Indicator shows two lines in its own pane: VI+ in green and VI- in red, around a baseline of 1.
When VI+ is above VI-, upward movement leads; when VI- is above, downward movement leads.
how: VM+ = |high - previous low|. VM- = |low - previous high|. VI+ = sum of VM+ over 14 bars / sum of true range over 14 bars. VI- = sum of VM- over 14 bars / sum of true range.
Only the length can be changed. Values above 1 mean the vortex movement was larger than the true range over the window.
use: Some traders watch VI+ crossing above VI- as the start of an uptrend.
Use a widening gap as a sign of a strong trend.
Watch the lines tangled near 1 as a range.
Pair it with ADX for strength.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
